text.en: Textual Inversions is row 25 of the BenchCouncil AI100 (2022-2023) annual table in the Multimodal area.
text.zh: Textual Inversions 是 BenchCouncil AI100（2022-2023）年度表第 25 行，所属领域为“多模态”。

text.en: The annual table associates Textual Inversions with “An Image is Worth One Word: Personalizing Text-to-Image Generation using Textual Inversion”.
text.zh: 年度表把 Textual Inversions 与论文《An Image is Worth One Word: Personalizing Text-to-Image Generation using Textual Inversion》关联。

text.en: The Main Contributors field is “Rinon Gal, Daniel Cohen-Or”.
text.zh: “主要人物”字段依次列出 Rinon Gal（官方页拼写）、Daniel Cohen-Or（官方页拼写）；官方英文原文为“Rinon Gal, Daniel Cohen-Or”。
